worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.summary: Raise a soft dome of light around yourself and nearby allies; special damage taken is cut, and the secondary effects of special moves are filtered down. The screen follows the caster, and anyone who leaves its reach loses the cover.
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.use.1: Weaken secondary statuses of special moves
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.use.2: Raise the screen before the foe's special push
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.descriptio: The light dome covers the caster and allies within %2$s blocks for %1$s.
Special damage taken is cut by %1$s, and the landing chance of a special move's secondary effect is filtered down by %2$s.
The screen holds about %1$s motes of light and moves with the caster.
Raising it takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. See the form note for the thick/thin trade-off.
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.form.0: Thick: special cut x1.18, but only about six tenths of the thin screen's secondary filtering, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.12 cooldown - thicker head-on cover.
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.form.1: Thin: special cut x0.8, but stronger secondary filtering (x1.3), -2 ticks wind-up, x0.9 cooldown - less raw cover, better against status and faster.
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.timing: Cast on yourself: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s and the cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.preference: Thick: special cut x1.18, secondary filtering about six tenths of the thin screen, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.12 cooldown. Thin: cut x0.8, filtering x1.3, -2 ticks wind-up, x0.9 cooldown.
The partner only considers the screen while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee pressure, larger prepares from farther away.
Under pressure: only while a foe is attacking the partner or its owner, or the partner was just hurt. Anytime: raise it on any threat.
When on, the screen is only raised while the partner or an ally within 6 blocks is below 65% health; off, it is raised on any threat.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to raise the screen.
